description: Get the transcript (with timestamps) for a YouTube video.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code to geo-target results (e.g. us, gb, in, de). (API default: us)

language.description: Result language code (e.g. en, es, fr, de). (API default: en)

v.description: YouTube video id (the part after ?v= in the URL).

name: youtube_transcripts
title: YouTube Transcripts API
